findings.evidence: roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/Multiquadratic/README.md:119–139 defines the genus field using all places and explicitly warns that the real case requires a distinct narrow genus field; the new definition at line 84 adjoins roots of all prime-discriminant radicands without any real-place condition.
findings.fix: Restrict this ordinary-genus-field interpretation to imaginary d, or rename/document the object as a narrow/finite-place candidate and introduce the ordinary real candidate only after encoding the infinite-place condition.
findings.issue: The docstrings at lines 14–16 and 78–82 claim this compositum is classically the genus field for every squarefree d, but for real d it generally represents the narrow candidate instead. For d = 3, disc = 12 factors as (-4)(-3), so the construction is ℚ(i,√−3)=ℚ(√3,i), whose extension over ℚ(√3) ramifies at the real places and is not the roadmap’s genus field unramified at all places.

summary: The construction conflates the narrow and ordinary genus fields for real quadratic fields, contradicting the roadmap’s explicit infinite-place convention.
